stage0074_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$赤城$$
「Damn it!
　The Federation's finest can't even touch them!!」

stage0074_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$飯塚$$
「Fall back, $$赤城$$!
　We can't push any further!」

stage0074_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$赤城$$
「But sir!
　There are still civilians out there...!」

stage0074_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$飯塚$$
「...For now, our priority is guiding evacuees
　to safety. Regrettably, we abandon Atami.」

stage0074_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Hmph...
　These ones are even weaker than the last.」

stage0074_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
Citizen
「Oh, it's over!
　Atami is finished!」

stage0074_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
Citizen
「It's not just Atami!
　The whole world's going to end!」

stage0074_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
Citizen
「T-today's the last day for the world!
　Have mercy, have mercy on us!」

stage0074_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「This city still carries traces of $$ゼウス$$.
　Burn it all to ashes.」

stage0074_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Especially that building. Make sure of it.」

stage0074_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$ローレライ$$
「But...!
　$$お菊$$ and $$クロス$$ asked me to protect
　the $$くろがね屋$$...!」

stage0074_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$ローレライ$$
「If it's come to this, I'll...」

stage0074_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$シロー$$
「$$ローレライ$$!
　You can't fight!」

stage0074_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$シロー$$
「You promised me and Bro
　you'd never fight again!」

stage0074_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$シロー$$
「Believe in Bro and $c!
　They'll definitely reach Atami!!」

stage0074_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$キャシー$$
「Mycenae... to think they'd go this far.」

stage0074_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Such overwhelming, merciless force...
　So this is what a god is.」

stage0074_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Those humans from before.
　Still coming back for more, are you.」

stage0074_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Tch... to think we'd end up hearing
　the line we always say to villains...!」

stage0074_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$シモン$$
「But today, we'll be the ones
　learning from their persistence...!」

stage0074_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$甲児$$
「Both me and Mazinger are wrecked,
　and there's barely any Photonic Power left...」

stage0074_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$甲児$$
「But when it comes to spirit,
　there's no way I'll lose to them!!」

stage0074_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$シロー$$
「Come on, $$ローレライ$$!
　Leave the fighting to Bro and the rest, run!」

stage0074_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Humans truly never evolve, do they!
　Back then, in the age of myth, the humans
　who rose against us said the same thing!」

stage0074_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Pride, honor, courage, what you must protect...!
　I'll show you how utterly powerless
　such things are before the power of gods!」

stage0074_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$カレン$$
「First, we take down the $$タロス像$$!
　Beat them and cut into the enemy's forces!」

stage0074_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
Kedora
「All who defy Mycenae will be erased...」

stage0074_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$アルト$$
「So that battle organism showed up after all!」

stage0074_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「The mechanical beast it took over showed
　monstrous strength! Stay on guard even
　against a $$タロス像$$!」

stage0074_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Each of them individually outclasses us in power!
　Advance in tight formation, and take them down
　one at a time with concentrated attacks!」

stage0074_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
（So you've made up your mind too.）

stage0074_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, begin the attack!
　We shall become the power to kill gods!」

stage0074_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$n
「The power to kill gods, huh...!
　Not bad!」

stage0074_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$甲児$$
「Here we come, $$ハーデス$$!!
　Take our all-out, do-or-die strength!!」

stage0074_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「I see...
　you've evolved a little since last time.」

stage0074_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「But at that sluggish pace,
　you'll never reach the throne of the gods
　before the wheel of rebirth closes!」

stage0074_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「You've made for decent time-killing, humans!
　But you can't beat even $$バアル$$, let alone us!」

stage0074_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Struggling against Kedora is the clearest
　proof of that!」

stage0074_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「I'll enlighten you.
　Kedora was made by implanting the brain of
　a hungry destroyer, built to fight $$バアル$$.」

stage0074_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$隼人$$
「A hungry destroyer...!
　So that means it's an $$インベーダー#keyword$$!」

stage0074_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$ボス$$
「Then that means there was an $$インベーダー#keyword$$
　in the Mycenaean ruins...!」

stage0074_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$甲児$$
「So it could be remade into Kedora!」

stage0074_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Even their endless urge to destroy
　becomes a loyal soldier, with our power!」

stage0074_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「If you can't even beat Kedora,
　you'll never stop $$バアル$$'s invasion!」

stage0074_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Be grateful!
　To the one who tried to stop this planet's
　time and save you from $$バアル$$!」

stage0074_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$n
「Shut up...!
　What hope is there in a world with no future!」

stage0074_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Big talk, for someone so weak!
　If it galls you, then grow stronger!」

stage0074_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Hahaha, fools!
　Then I'll show you your own powerlessness!」

stage0074_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$甲児$$
「Like I'd stop!
　Not from something like this!!」

stage0074_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$甲児$$
「I... won't give up on hope!」

stage0074_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「So, you've come, apostle of the Getter rays!」

stage0074_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$號$$
「You're not the one I'm here for!」

stage0074_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$號$$
「Feel it, $$甲児$$!
　The life within you! The light!!」

stage0074_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Impossible!
　$$ゼウス$$'s power was supposed to be lost!」

stage0074_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Damn him!
　Don't tell me... he used Getter rays to evolve...!」

stage0074_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$號$$
「That's right.
　I amplified the light inside me,
　and made it my strength.」

stage0074_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Tch!
　Apostle of the Getter rays!
　Forcing evolution onto humans, are you!」

stage0074_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$號$$
「Light is born wherever there's hope.
　Human will paves the road to the future.」

stage0074_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$タケル$$
「You were supposed to be unconscious.
　How do you know that?」

stage0074_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$甲児$$
「He entrusted it to me.
　In a universe beyond time and space.」

stage0074_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$號$$
「That's right.
　Everyone carries light in their heart.」

stage0074_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$號$$
「Mycenae, dark god trying to shroud it in darkness!
　I won't allow the likes of you to exist!」

stage0074_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$弁慶$$
「$$渓$$ and $$凱$$ are here too!」

stage0074_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$渓$$
「Sorry to keep you waiting so long,
　but $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$'s on the move now!
　We're fighting too!」

stage0074_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$ギミー$$
「Now we're strong as a hundred men!!」

stage0074_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$隼人$$
（$$真ゲッタードラゴン$$'s awakening...
　Does it relate to Mycenae's revival...）

stage0074_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$號$$
「$$隼人$$, let's focus on the enemy in front of us.」

stage0074_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$隼人$$
「Heh... you're right.
　Those who can't get through today
　have no right to dream of tomorrow.」

stage0074_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「How could I not laugh at this?!」

stage0074_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Very well, you humans!
　If that's the path of evolution you walk,
　then show it to me!」

stage0074_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「For that is the greatest rebellion against them!」

stage0074_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Those who tried to hide this star in the
　Prison of Time...! To make them howl,
　I'll test the strength of you all!」

stage0074_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「I, $$ハーデス$$, King of the Underworld, command it!
　$$ガラダブラ$$, hero of Olympus!
　Offer up your soul to me once more!!」

stage0074_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Oh! Ohhhhh!
　My body returns to the material world once again!!」

stage0074_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Tristan and Isolde split your body
　in two, and kept it preserved all this time.」

stage0074_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「I, $$ハーデス$$, King of the Underworld, have
　called your soul back into those remains.
　Fight to your heart's content, $$勇者ガラダブラ#pilot$$!」

stage0074_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Thank you, Master $$ハーデス$$!
　I, $$ガラダブラ$$, shall fight a battle
　worthy of a hero for the King of the Underworld!」

stage0074_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Th-that thing... it's not some kind of
　combined Mechanical Beast!」

stage0074_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$赤木$$
「Garada and Doublas were originally one body!」

stage0074_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$葵$$
「Twice the horror...!
　And more than twice the toughness, I'd say!」

stage0074_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「You humans!
　$$ガラダブラ$$, hailed as Mycenae's hero,
　shall put your future to the test!」

stage0074_04:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「If you cannot prove your strength here,
　then you shall all die on this very spot!」

stage0074_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Leave the rest to me, Master $$ハーデス$$」

stage0074_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Now then, you humans!
　Satisfy the fighting spirit of one who's
　finally got a body again, after so long!」

stage0074_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$甲児$$
「We don't have time for your games!
　We're going all out!!」

stage0074_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$竜馬$$
「$$號$$! $$渓$$, $$凱$$!
　For a comeback match, these guys are tough!」

stage0074_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$凱$$
「I get it without you saying it, $$號$$」

stage0074_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$渓$$
「For our sake... for humanity's future,
　we can't afford to lose to them...!」

stage0074_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$號$$
「Let's go!
　To protect a future overflowing with light!」

stage0074_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$甲児$$
「Let's settle this, $$ガラダブラ$$!!
　I'll show you the power of my... Mazinger's light!!」

stage0074_04:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Not bad, human!
　No wonder Master $$ハーデス$$ took notice of you!」

stage0074_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「I look forward to seeing
　just how high you all can climb from here!」

stage0074_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Heh... even a god throws a parting shot.」

stage0074_04:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$號$$
「$$甲児$$...
　Today's victory is a miracle
　summoned by your strong heart.」

stage0074_04:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「That's right, $$甲児$$.
　A miracle isn't something that happens,
　it's something you make happen.」

stage0074_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「'Fluke' is one way to put it.」

stage0074_04:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$シン$$
「Hey, you...
　you're a part of $c now,
　so don't call your own victory a fluke.」

stage0074_04:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$クェス$$
「You beat a god!
　You should just be honest and celebrate it!」

stage0074_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Still, $$ギュネイ$$ has a point.
　We won today, but that doesn't mean
　we'll win again next time.」

stage0074_04:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$バナージ$$
「We have to get stronger, don't we...」

stage0074_04:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$刹那$$
「To borrow their own words,
　it's not just us, but humanity as a whole,
　that needs to evolve.」

stage0074_04:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$宗介$$
「But what should we do?
　Keep training like $n does?」

stage0074_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$n
「We already know the answer to that.」

stage0074_04:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$號$$
「Where there is hope, light is born...」

stage0074_04:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$甲児$$
（$$ゼウス$$...
　We'll carry those words in our hearts as we fight.）

stage0074_04:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$甲児$$
「What are you all doing!
　Run now, or things will get bad!」

stage0074_04:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
Citizen
「I-it was just a moment of weakness!」

stage0074_04:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
Citizen
「That mansion... no one was living there,
　so we thought it'd been abandoned!」

stage0074_04:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
Citizen
「W-we'll return what we took,
　so please forgive us～!」

stage0074_04:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$甲児$$
「Chogokin Z...!
　They took it from my house!」

stage0074_04:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$甲児$$
（If Chogokin Z is part of $$ゼウス$$,
　maybe the Mycenaeans were drawn to it,
　and that's why they showed up in Atami...）

stage0074_04:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$甲児$$
（Even if this life of mine ends here, I will fight!）

stage0074_04:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$甲児$$
（You gods of Mycenae, who think human life
　no better than insects!
　Even in death, I will not yield to you!）

stage0074_04:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$竜馬$$
（Maybe my number's up, right here...）

stage0074_04:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$竜馬$$
「But you know what!
　Even facing death, I go down swinging!
　Don't think you can beat me, Mycenae!!」

stage0074_04:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$ゼロ$$
（You who trample human dignity
　in the name of a god...!）

stage0074_04:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$ゼロ$$
（As if beings like you stand above humanity!
　We'll prove that, right here!!）

stage0074_04:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$赤木$$
「Damn it!
　Atami was a town with beautiful scenery,
　great food, and relaxing hot springs!」

stage0074_04:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$赤木$$
「Do you even understand, all of you!?
　People used to live here!」

stage0074_04:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$赤木$$
「And the likes of you dare call yourselves gods!!」

stage0074_04:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$號$$
「$$真ゲッタードラゴン$$ has awakened!
　To save this planet and humanity!」

stage0074_04:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$凱$$
「I know, $$號$$!
　And our mission too!」

stage0074_04:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$渓$$
「We'll protect humanity's future
　with the power of Getter!
　And we won't lose to the likes of them!」

stage0074_04:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$號$$
「$$渓$$, $$凱$$...!
　Now is the time to unite our strength once more!」

stage0074_04:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$號$$
「Let's go, Getter!!
　Our true battle begins now!!」

stage0074_04:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$ハーデス$$!
　I'm paying you back for what you did to me!」

stage0074_04:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「You fool who lent $$ゼウス$$ a hand!
　So you're still alive!」

stage0074_04:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Then I'll tear you limb from limb,
　and shove your corpse in $$ゼウス$$'s face!!」

stage0074_04:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$甲児$$
「Go ahead and try it, if you can!
　But I won't go down without a fight
　either!!」

stage0074_04:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「The remains of my flesh remember!
　The pain of the wounds you carved into it!」

stage0074_04:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「And my soul remembers as well!
　That in the age of myth, you sided with $$ゼウス$$
　and fought against this $$勇者ガラダブラ#pilot$$!」

stage0074_04:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$甲児$$
「I don't care about the past!
　What matters to me right now
　is taking you down!!」

stage0074_04:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$甲児$$
「Let's do it, Mazinger!
　This is a fight for our lives!!」

stage0074_04:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$竜馬$$
「God, hero, whatever title, who cares!
　Beating every enemy is just how I live!!」

stage0074_04:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「You dare charge at me so recklessly, human!」

stage0074_04:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$竜馬$$
「That bluff won't work on me!
　If you want me to shut up, show me some real power!」

stage0074_04:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「That form...!
　A kin of Getter, are you!」

stage0074_04:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$渓$$
「It knows $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$!?」

stage0074_04:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$凱$$
「Trying to scare us like that
　won't get you anywhere!」

stage0074_04:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「I see!
　No wonder, a star full of $$オリジン・ロー$$!
　You may well be the chosen humans after all!」

stage0074_04:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$號$$
「You're wrong!
　We weren't chosen,
　we choose our own future, with our own strength!」

stage0074_04:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$號$$
「That's what our fight is...!
　In other words, it's living!!」

stage0074_04:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Hey now, three-headed skeleton!
　Hero or whatever you call yourself, I've got an
　unbeatable reputation riding on me too!」

stage0074_04:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Don't make me laugh, little brat!
　Get lost before you wet yourself!」

stage0074_04:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Don't think you can talk big forever!
　I'm giving this everything I've got!!」

stage0074_04:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Watch closely, god!
　I'll show you the pride of a man named $$ワッ太$$!!」

stage0074_04:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Playtime with your dolls is over!
　This $$勇者ガラダブラ#pilot$$ will crush that
　junk you humans are so proud of!」

stage0074_04:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$正太郎$$
「I won't let you!
　$$鉄人$$ is the Sun's messenger...!
　He's our hope!!」

stage0074_04:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「The Sun's messenger, you say...!?」

stage0074_04:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「I see!
　So you stand at the threshold
　between ruin and evolution!」

stage0074_04:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「I feel it...!
　I feel the blood of beasts within you!」

stage0074_04:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$葵$$
「So you're sensing our wild side, huh!」

stage0074_04:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$葵$$
「Feeling it is just the start!
　You're going to experience our burning souls
　firsthand!!」

stage0074_04:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Just as I thought!
　It seems Master $$ハーデス$$ has judged this place
　to be where myth comes to an end!」

stage0074_04:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$赤木$$
「$$いぶき$$, $$青山$$!
　We're stopping this thing here, no matter what!」

stage0074_04:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「So you don't fear this $$勇者ガラダブラ#pilot$$!
　I'll give you that much credit, human!」

stage0074_04:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$赤木$$
「If you're a hero, then I'm a salaryman!
　When it comes to pride, I won't lose to you!」

stage0074_04:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Salaryman!?
　Is that the title humans give their heroes!?」

stage0074_04:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$赤木$$
「That's right!
　I'll show you the power of people
　who take pride in their work and fight for it!!」

stage0074_04:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「I understand...!
　You're a survivor of a civilization of fire
　that reached its very peak!」

stage0074_04:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「I don't know what you're talking about,
　but I'm no ordinary fire!」

stage0074_04:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「In my heart, the flame called Big Sis
　is always burning!」

stage0074_04:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Combine that with my own flame,
　and $$ガンバスター$$ becomes a blaze!!」

stage0074_04:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$シンジ$$
「So strong...!
　No wonder they call you a hero!」

stage0074_04:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Boy!
　If you understand that, then get lost already!」

stage0074_04:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Can't hear you!
　Not that I ever meant to listen
　to any begging for mercy anyway!」

stage0074_04:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$シンジ$$
「But I'm a member of $c too!」

stage0074_04:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I have to fight!
　Everyone's risking their life out there!
　I can too... I can tooooo!!」

stage0074_04:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「You humans!
　Fighting on without even knowing
　where the wind leads you!?」

stage0074_04:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$シモン$$
「Shut up, skeleton!
　I decide where I'm headed!
　I won't let the likes of you butt in!」

stage0074_04:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「So you don't even know the meaning of ruin!
　Then this $$勇者ガラダブラ#pilot$$
　will deliver your last rites!」

stage0074_04:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Don't make me laugh!
　A hero's name doesn't suit someone
　who's already died once!」

stage0074_04:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$シモン$$
「Bring it on!
　I'll teach you the taste of defeat all over again!!」

stage0074_04:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「A confluence of waters...!
　Those fools, gathering every era together,
　meaning to turn this into a paradise frozen in time!?」

stage0074_04:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Humanity has no need to know that meaning!
　It is your fate to rot away on the path of evolution!」

stage0074_04:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$アマタ$$
「No way... I refuse to be killed over logic like that!」

stage0074_04:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$アマタ$$
「We're alive!
　I won't hand this life over to anyone!!」

stage0074_04:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「$$オリジン・ロー$$...!
　So there's another here who walks the age of the sun!」

stage0074_04:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$n
「Sorry, but I don't have the luxury
　of listening to divine oracles right now...!」

stage0074_04:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$n
「Even if you're gods,
　I can't afford to stop here!」

stage0074_04:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$n
「I'll beat you all, and then settle things with them!!」

stage0074_04:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Tch!
　This one alone is too dangerous to leave be!!」

stage0074_04:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「I understand... I understand now!
　So this is the ultimate form of human civilization!?」

stage0074_04:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Come, then!
　This $$勇者ガラダブラ#pilot$$ will be your opponent!」
